2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Denver’s defense tries to make Patrick Mahomes win from patience rather than improvisation
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: Kansas City expects Patrick Mahomes to play without limitations after his knee rehab, but Denver arrives with a defense that has recently made this matchup uncomfortable by compressing explosive plays and forcing longer possessions. The Broncos also bring back the core of a strong unit, while their offense still has to prove it can stay efficient on early downs. Kansas City’s challenge is to protect Mahomes without becoming static, and Denver’s is to create pressure while keeping scramble lanes and secondary coverage intact.
2026_01_DEN_KC.model_rationale: Denver’s defense can keep Kansas City from living on explosive plays, but the Chiefs remain dangerous if protection holds and Mahomes can extend possessions without being forced into predictable situations.
